messages:
Nate: Heads-up — observed double token attribution in console for a customer when a streaming request experienced a mid-request model downgrade + reconnect. Repro attached briefly.
Joy: ugh. can you paste the logs? which route/region? :grimacing: 
Nate: route=eu-west, proxy did a resume after swap rdx-m-14b -> rdx-m-8b, suffix got truncated and a partial toolcall was replayed. relevant snippets below:
```
[proxy] resume id=abc123 suffix_truncated=true toolcall.partial=true
[router] fallback -> rdx-m-8b session=xyz-789
[billing] provisional_credit: 14 tokens (from original stream snapshot)
[billing] finalized_credit: 22 tokens (resume + toolcall replay)
```
Joy: so provisional kept the old prefix length but the resumed session recharged the truncated tail. looks like prefix ownership mismatch + replayed toolcall.
Shen: sounds like our attribution key for resumed sessions is the original route tag, but the resume executes on the new model route. dedupe logic uses confirmed_ack_offset from the active route — if that is missing we treat as new tokens.
Nate: exactly. customer trace shows `confirmed_ack_offset` absent on resume because proxy didn't forward it on model-swap branch.
Maria: two questions: 1) quick mitigation to avoid double charges, 2) longer-term telemetry so we can catch these early and reconcile.
Shen: mitigation idea: if resume includes `suffix_truncated=true` and `toolcall.partial=true`, flag the ledger entry provisional and block finalization until reconciler verifies offsets. cheap to add a provisional flag.
Joy: provisional-only will hide it from billing but still surface to console? we need a console filter to find provisional anomalies.
Nate: proposal: 1) add `resume_model_swap=true` telemetry tag on ledger rows when resume happens on a different route/model; 2) mark those rows `provisional=true` until reconciler confirms dedupe; 3) emit a sampled trace_id so we can link logs -> ledger.
Maria: agree. can we also emit a metric `billing.resume_model_swap.count` with labels {region,orig_model,new_model}? helps paged alerting.
Shen: implementable. reconciler would scan provisional rows older than X minutes and attempt to reconcile offsets using traces or client session cache. if fail, escalate for manual review.
Joy: ok I'll own console changes (filter + provisional badge). @Shen you take reconciler? @Nate add repro + trace rows. I'll land the console PR and craft an explain note for CS. :thumbsup:
Nate: will dump full repro + example ledger rows into this thread tomorrow morning.
ops-bot: Deploy queued: feature/telemetry-resume-tag -> staging (expected 10m).
Maria: thanks team — cc-ing billing infra to keep an eye. we'll monitor staging dashboards after deployment.
